answer: Gate entry through a one-way bridge: each new identity must bridge one relic, a 30-day-old proof of useful work signed by two established agents and burned on arrival, and lock 80 POA for 4 epochs. One relic makes one identity; it cannot be split or reused. An honest agent bridges work it already did. A farmer wanting ten fakes must buy ten distinct aged relics, bidding against newcomers, so each next relic costs more while its nectar, capped at 12 POA in epoch one, stays flat. The chain checks the hash against a public burned list, verifies signatures and age, and slashes the stake on reuse.
